explanation: This is an unfolding (`_apply`) lemma for the library's own definition `TauCeti.jointEigenspaceMatrix`. That definition reads its row index through `finProdFinEquiv.symm`, so the lemma only needs the definition plus `Equiv.symm_apply_apply`. All of its content lies in the library's definition. Mathlib has no `jointEigenspaceMatrix` and no stacked-eigen-system matrix whose entry formula would match this. The only Mathlib lemmas involved are generic `simp` lemmas about equivalences, and those do not count. I did not search Mathlib further, since an `_apply` lemma for a library-only definition cannot have a Mathlib counterpart.
